about_the_game:
Say hello to your new desktop bestie! In Collector’s Companion, the lovable animal companion from Collector’s Cove is here to keep you company—just chillin’, paddling her little fins, and being her adorable self.

As you type, click, play and go about your day, every input earns you points. Save them up to unlock a growing collection of adorable hats and colorful skins to style your companion just the way you like.

There’s no pressure, no complex gameplay—just cozy desktop vibes and a cute little friend paddling along while you do your thing.

🐾 Features:

  • An adorable animal companion who paddles her fins and keeps you company

  • Earn points with every keyboard or mouse input

  • Unlock hats and skins to customize your buddy

  • Light, passive fun with a big dose of cuteness

  • Perfect for fans of Collector’s Cove or anyone who loves chill desktop companions

🎁 Item Drop Pool Chances

Use your points to roll from a pool of cosmetic items, each with their own rarity:

  • ⚪ Common (90%)

  • 🟢 Uncommon (9,5%)

  • 🔵 Rare (0,49%)

  • 🟣 Epic (0,01%)

  • 🟡 Legendary (1 in 500000)

All items are purely cosmetic—just for fun, flair, and style. Can you collect them all?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 5200 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 10500 or AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: She’s not here to work—she’s here to paddle! Your favorite animal companion from Collector’s Cove is now your desktop buddy, gently paddling her fins and looking cute while you do all the hard stuff. Gather points while you type, click and play and collect a multitude of different hats and skins!
